an6.3:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an6.3:1.3: saddhindriyena viriyindriyena satindriyena samādhindriyena paññindriyena, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an6.3:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chabhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
